summary: # Guide: Adding Support for New Models This guide will help you add support for a new LLM model/provider to prompt-tokens. > **Important**: Before starting, please review the [Rust Best Practices](../OPEN_SOURCE_PLAN.md#-rust-best-practices) section to ensure your code follows project standards. ## Overview Adding a new model involves: 1. Understanding the model's tokenizer 2. Implementing the `Tokenizer` trait 3. Registering the model in the registry 4. Adding pricing information 5. Writing tests
